full_judgment: 2. The petitioner instituted Other Class Suit No .76 of 1994 in the Court of learned Senior Assistant Judge, Thakurgaon, for specific performance of contract. His case is that the land in suit appertaining to C.S. Khatian No. 776, Plot No. 202 of mouja Jagannathpur, P. S. Thakurgaon, District-Thakurgaon measuring an area of 312 decimals out of 54 decimals belonged to the mother of the defendants. These defendant Nos. 1 and 2 were minors, who inherited the suit land from their mother. Their father, Taslim Uddin entered into a con, tract for sale of the said land with the plaintiff at a consideration money of Tk. 36,000/- out of which he received Tk. 7,000/- as earnest money on 9th September, 1994. It was stipulated that the balance money of Tk. 29,000/- would be paid within 9th December, 1994 and the father of the defendant Nos. 1 and 2 on receipt of the said money would execute and register the sale deed in favour of the plaintiff. The plaintiff approached to the father of defendant Nos. 1 and 2 on 19th October, 1994 to receive the balance consideration money and to execute and register a sale deed but in vain. On 29th October, 1994 it was disclosed that the said land was transferred in favour of the defendant No.3 by kabala deed dated 22nd October, 1994 and as such, the suit.
